\code{clk_i} & in & 1 & clock & Clock of the destination domain.\\
\code{rst_n_i} & in & 1 & async & Active-low source reset. It is not synchronous to \code{clk_i}. It is the asynchronous clear of the chain when \code{scanmode_i} is low.\\
\code{scanmode_i} & in & 1 & quasi-static & Scan mode. When high, \code{scan_rst_ni} replaces \code{rst_n_i} as the clear of the chain and is the output. Tie low without scan. Do not change it while \code{clk_i} runs.\\
\code{scan_rst_ni} & in & 1 & async & Active-low scan reset. It is used only when \code{scanmode_i} is high. Tie high without scan.\\
\code{rst_n_o} & out & 1 & \code{clk_i} & Active-low reset for the destination domain. It asserts at once when the reset asserts. It deasserts after STAGES edges of \code{clk_i}. When \code{scanmode_i} is high it equals \code{scan_rst_ni}.\\
\end{longtable}
